questions.question: Explain how the biological and cognitive approaches differ in explaining depression

points.text: Biological: genetic predisposition, serotonin/noradrenaline deficit, hippocampal atrophy -> treatment: SSRIs, ECT. Cognitive: Beck's negative triad (self, world, future), cognitive distortions, schema -> treatment: CBT (challenge thoughts). Biological = reductionist, medical; Cognitive = mental processes, empowerment
